events.title: Cheesty's Demo is here!
events.summary: Starting today, you can try Cheesty! The Cheesty demo is now available. I can't wait for you to try the game, and it means a lot to me that you're part of this adventure. I'll be reading every review you leave so I can keep improving the game before its launch on November 12th.I hope you enjoy it!

events.title: Welcome to Garsa Games
events.summary: Hey everyone! I'm Álvaro, the solo developer behind Garsa Games and Cheesty. Cheesty is my first video game, and I've been developing it for more than a year. It's a 3D adventure about a tiny lab rat trying to escape and find freedom. You'll explore a huge world from her perspective, solve puzzles, avoid dangers, investigate your surroundings and discover her story.
